text: In a distributed system, multiple users are trying to access and update the same data at the same time, leading to conflicts and slowdowns. answers.answer_text: Implement a Last-Write-Wins policy, resolving conflicts by accepting the most recent write

Use Two-Phase Locking (2PL) to acquire and release locks in phases
